name: System Administrator
description: Full platform authority: registers new identities, assigns RBAC roles, revokes access, and deploys contract upgrades.

name: Asset & Department Manager
description: Authorized to initiate digital asset creation (minting) and manage operational transfers across team members.

name: Independent Auditor / BEL Security
description: Read-only access across all transaction logs, identity events, asset movements, and verification proofs.

name: Registered Participant
description: Standard identity authorized to hold, view, and interact with designated digital assets.
